p1g2.instruction: Do the following statements agree with the information given in Reading Passage? In boxes 7-10 on your answer sheet, write YES if the statement agrees with the views of the writer, NO if the statement contradicts the views of the writer, NOT GIVEN if it is impossible to say what the writer thinks about this.

7.prompt: Drucker believed the employees should enjoy the same status as the employers in a company

8.prompt: Drucker argued the managers and politicians will dominate the economy during a social transition

9.prompt: Drucker support that workers are not simply put themselves just in the employment relationship and should develop their resources of intelligence voluntarily

10.prompt: Drucker's work on the management is out of date in moderns days

optionBank.title: Options
labels: High-rank executives and workers should be put in balanced positions in management practice

More emphasis should be laid on fostering the development of the union.

Leaders should go beyond the scope of management details and strategically establish goals
